info.title: SmartCity Backend API
info.description: REST API for managing public buildings and energy devices in a smart city

put.summary: Update energy consumption of a building
put.description: Updates the energy consumption value and unit for a specific public building identified by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building whose consumption is to be updated.

requestBody.description: The new energy consumption value and unit to assign to the building.

200.description: Energy consumption updated successfully for the specified building.

400.description: Invalid request data, such as a negative consumption value or an unsupported energy unit.

example.message: Validation failed: consumption value must be non-negative.

404.description: No public building found with the provided UUID.

example.message: Public building with id 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890' was not found.

patch.summary: Update energy consumption of a building
patch.description: Updates the energy consumption value and unit for a specific public building. Requires ADMIN role. Returns no content on success.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building whose consumption is to be updated

204.description: Energy consumption updated successfully. No content returned.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity – The provided consumption value or unit is semantically invalid (e.g., negative consumption value or unsupported energy unit).

example.message: Consumption value must be greater than zero.

400.description: Bad Request – The request body is malformed or contains missing required fields such as consumptionValue or consumptionUnit.

404.description: Not Found – No public building exists with the specified ID.

example.message: Public building with id 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890' was not found.

409.description: Conflict – The consumption update conflicts with the current state of the building (e.g., concurrent modification detected).

example.message: Building consumption was modified by another request. Please retry.

post.description: Creates a new public building asset in the smart city system. Requires ADMIN role. Returns the UUID of the newly created building.

201.description: Public building successfully created. Returns the unique identifier of the new building.

422.description: Business rule violation. The building could not be created due to a domain constraint, such as a duplicate name or invalid location.

400.description: Invalid request payload. One or more required fields are missing or fail validation constraints.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of all registered public buildings
get.description: Returns all public buildings tracked in the smart city system, including their energy consumption details and associated energy devices.

200.description: A list of all public buildings was successfully retrieved.

post.summary: Add an energy device to a building
post.description: Registers a new energy device (e.g. solar panel, EV charger, smart meter) and associates it with the specified public building. Returns no content on success.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building to which the device will be added.

204.description: Device successfully added to the building. No content is returned.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity – the request body is syntactically valid but contains semantic errors, such as an unsupported device type or an invalid energy unit combination.

example.message: Device type 'UNKNOWN' is not supported for public buildings.

400.description: Bad Request – one or more required fields are missing or fail validation constraints (e.g. blank device name, null energy unit).

404.description: Not Found – no public building exists with the provided identifier.

example.message: Public building with id '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6' was not found.

409.description: Conflict – a device with the same identifier or name already exists within this building.

example.message: A device named 'Solar Panel A1' already exists in building '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6'.

patch.summary: Update production rate of a device
patch.description: Updates the energy production rate of a specific device within a public building. The device must belong to the specified building and must be a production-capable device (e.g., solar panel, wind turbine).

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building that owns the device

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the energy-producing device to update

204.description: Production rate updated successfully. No content is returned.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — the provided production value or unit is semantically invalid (e.g., negative production value or unsupported energy unit for this device type).

example.message: Production value must be greater than zero

400.description: Bad Request — the request body is malformed or contains missing required fields such as productionValue or productionUnit.

404.description: Not Found — no public building exists with the given buildingId, or no device with the given deviceId belongs to that building.

example.message: Device with id '7cb94e21-1a3b-4d8e-9f02-abc123def456' not found in building '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6'

409.description: Conflict — the device is not a production-capable device and cannot have a production rate assigned, or a concurrent update conflict was detected.

example.message: Device '7cb94e21-1a3b-4d8e-9f02-abc123def456' does not support energy production

get.summary: Get a public building by ID
get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific public building, including its energy consumption data and associated energy devices.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building to retrieve.

200.description: Public building found and returned successfully.

404.description: No public building was found with the specified ID.

example.message: Public building with ID '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6' does not exist.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all registered public buildings in the smart city, including their energy consumption details and associated devices.

200.description: A list of all public buildings was successfully retrieved.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new JWT + new refresh token
post.description: Accepts a valid refresh token and issues a new short-lived JWT access token together with a rotated refresh token. The previous refresh token is invalidated immediately after use. Use this endpoint to silently renew a session without requiring the user to re-enter credentials.

requestBody.description: The refresh token previously issued during login or a prior token refresh.

200.description: Token refresh successful. Returns a new JWT access token and a rotated refresh token. The client should replace both stored tokens immediately.

post.summary: Revoke the current JWT and its refresh token
post.description: Invalidates the provided JWT access token and its associated refresh token, effectively ending the user's session. After a successful logout, both tokens are blacklisted and can no longer be used for authentication.

200.description: Session successfully terminated. The JWT access token and its associated refresh token have been revoked and are no longer valid.

post.summary: Authenticate and receive a JWT + refresh token

requestBody.description: User credentials required to authenticate and obtain access tokens

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns a signed JWT access token and a refresh token for session management.

ChangeConsumptionRequest.description: Request payload for updating the energy consumption value and unit of a city asset.

consumptionValue.description: The new energy consumption value for the asset. Must be zero or a positive number.

consumptionUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the energy consumption value.

CreateBuildingRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new building asset in the smart city system.

name.description: The unique human-readable name of the building.

location.description: The physical address or geographic location of the building.

AddDeviceRequest.description: Request payload for adding a new device to a smart city asset. Specifies the device type and its rated energy capacity.

type.description: The type of device being added. SOLAR for photovoltaic panels, PUMP for energy pumps, BATTERY for energy storage units.

ratedCapacityValue.description: The rated capacity value of the device. Must be a positive number representing the device's maximum energy output or storage capacity.

ratedCapacityUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the rated capacity value. Represents the scale of energy capacity (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts).

ChangeProductionRequest.description: Request payload for updating the energy production value and unit of an asset

productionValue.description: The new energy production value for the asset. Must be zero or positive.

productionUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the energy production value (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts)

EnergyDeviceResponse.description: Represents an energy device asset within the smart city infrastructure, including its type, rated capacity, and production rate.

id.description: Unique identifier of the energy device.

type.description: The category of the energy device (e.g., solar panel array, pump, or battery storage unit).

ratedCapacityValue.description: The maximum rated capacity of the energy device expressed as a numeric value.

ratedCapacityUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the rated capacity of the energy device.

productionRateValue.description: The current or nominal energy production rate of the device expressed as a numeric value.

productionRateUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the energy production rate of the device.

PublicBuildingResponse.description: Represents a public building asset in the smart city system, including its energy consumption details and associated energy devices.

id.description: Unique identifier of the public building.

location.description: Physical address or geographic location of the public building.

consumptionValue.description: Current energy consumption value of the building, expressed in the unit specified by consumptionUnit.

consumptionUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the energy consumption value (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts).

devices.description: List of energy devices installed in the public building that contribute to its overall energy consumption.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response returned by the API when a request fails. Contains details about the error code, human-readable message, HTTP status, time of occurrence, and a unique request identifier for tracing.

errorCode.description: Application-specific error code identifying the type of error.

message.description: Human-readable description of the error that occurred.
message.example: Asset with ID 42 was not found in the system.

status.description: HTTP status code associated with the error response.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the error occurred.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the request, useful for correlating logs and tracing the error across services.

RefreshRequest.description: Request payload containing a refresh token used to obtain a new access token

refreshToken.description: The refresh token previously issued during authentication

LoginResponse.description: Response returned upon successful authentication, containing the JWT access token, user role, token expiry duration, and a refresh token.

token.description: JWT access token to be included in the Authorization header for subsequent requests.

role.description: Role assigned to the authenticated user, determining their access level within the Smart City platform.

expiresInMs.description: Duration in milliseconds until the access token expires, starting from the moment of issuance.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token used to obtain a new access token once the current one has expired, without requiring re-authentication.

LogoutRequest.description: Request payload for logging out a user by invalidating their refresh token

refreshToken.description: The refresh token issued during authentication that should be invalidated on logout

LoginRequest.description: Credentials required to authenticate a user and obtain an access token.

username.description: The unique username of the registered user.

password.description: The password associated with the user account.
